title: Mapping-space pushout for three directed quasicategorical faces
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, faces, quasicategories and right mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], coherent rigidification $\mathfrak C$ and its simplicial mapping sets of [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison], and derived enriched coends in chronological order from [lem-coef-derived-space-module-coyoneda]. Let $K\to H=\Lambda^3_2$ be a simplicial map. For every nonempty face $J$ in $H$, put $K_J=K\times_H\Delta^J$ and assume $K_J$ is a quasicategory. Write $A_i=\mathfrak C[K_{\{i\}}]$. For $i<j$, write $M_{ij}(u,v)=\mathfrak C[K_{\{i,j\}}](u,v)$, a simplicial bimodule on $A_i^{\mathrm{op}}\times A_j$ by enriched composition. For $x\in K_0$, $z\in K_3$, define the following homotopy types of spaces:
$$P(x,z)=M_{01}(x,-)\otimes_{A_1}^{\mathbb L}M_{13}(-,z),$$
$$R(x,z)=M_{01}(x,-)\otimes_{A_1}^{\mathbb L}M_{12}\otimes_{A_2}^{\mathbb L}M_{23}(-,z),$$
$$D(x,z)=M_{03}(x,z).$$
All composition maps here are maps in the homotopy theory of enriched modules: compose in the indicated triangle face and invert its full-edge mapping comparison, supplied by [lem-coef-pinched-rigidification-resolution]. They do not require a strict retraction from a triangle face to an edge face. Composition in the face $K_{123}$ gives $R\to P$. Composition first in $K_{012}$ and then in $K_{023}$ gives $R\to D$. These maps, together with composition in $\mathfrak C[K]$, induce a natural equivalence of homotopy types
$$P(x,z)\amalg^h_{R(x,z)}D(x,z)\simeq\mathfrak C[K](x,z).$$
Here the left side is a homotopy pushout of spaces, not an ordinary pushout of component sets; under this equivalence its map from $D$ is induced by the actual inclusion $K_{03}\hookrightarrow K$. For vertices $u\in K_i$, $v\in K_j$ with $i\leq j$ and $(i,j)\ne(0,3)$, the actual inclusion of any face $F\subseteq H$ containing $i,j$ induces a weak homotopy equivalence
$$\mathfrak C[K_F](u,v)\longrightarrow\mathfrak C[K](u,v).$$
All these comparisons are natural for simplicial maps over $H$. No cocartesian lifts, categorical enlargement of $K$, or face equivalence after such an enlargement is assumed or concluded.
